en.title: Compressing Array
en.description:
You may repeatedly merge two adjacent elements, replacing them with their product; a merge is allowed only when the product is ≤k. All elements are positive integers. Find the shortest array length reachable after any sequence of operations.

See the statement and review notes for the problem source and the input protocol added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n and k; the second line contains n positive integers a[i]. The original constraints are corrupted; this site adds: 1≤n≤200000, 1≤a[i]≤10^9, 1≤k≤10^18.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the accompanying notes for the detailed approach.
hints: Greedily extend the current segment from left to right: as long as the segment product times the next number is still ≤k, merge it in; otherwise end the current segment and start a new one at the next number. Positive integers guarantee the product is non-decreasing as the segment grows.
